test_cases.test_case: Very long Username retained after failed login

test_cases.expected_result: Login is blocked / error shown: an inline error message is displayed; the Password field is cleared; the Username field displays the retained value — the tester should observe whether the displayed Username preserves the leading/trailing whitespace or shows a trimmed value (this observation is recorded by the test run)
